title: Combining lipidomics and machine learning to measure clinical lipids in dried blood spots
summary: Random-forest feature selection mapped plasma lipid profiles to triglyceride, HDL, LDL and total-cholesterol concentrations in plasma (n=777) and dried-blood-spot samples (n=835). Correlations varied by lipid and were lower for some DBS measures; the authors note further work is needed before health-monitoring use.
ai_technology: Random-forest feature selection maps plasma lipid measurements to dried-blood-spot lipid values.
organization: Core Metabolomics and Lipidomics Laboratory, Metabolic Research Laboratories, Institute of Metabolic Science, University of Cambridge, Level 4 Pathology, Cambridge Biomedical Campus, Cambridge, CB2 0QQ, UK.

evidence.unknown: The reported cohort or experimental dataset, comparator/reference and validation are specific to this case; conclusions remain bounded to that setting.
